title: Mission e nder wuro ɓooyngo
intro: Wuro ɓooyngo duƴƴungo, yimɓe mum ɓuuɓɓe e yeddude, e jeertinaango sakkitiingo ngo yahraani no haanirta nii. Hannde, naata e darnde nelaaɓe Alla ngam yettinde konngol e leñol tiiɗngol. Daartol jaɓgol, daande wootere goonɗinal, e joofnirde siimtunde e yamiroore bonnde. Hol kaaloowo e ɗeen ɗoo nate?
clues: En neldaa ko Alla e wuro ngo yimɓe mum njalti e goonga
Min ɗiɗo ngari ko adii, caggal ɗuum tataɓo naati ngam semmbinde golle amen
Wuro ngoo salii en, mbiyi en ngonaa hay huunde so wonaa yimɓe hono maɓɓe
Ruuhu gooto ummoriiɗo e damal wuro ɓurngo woɗɗude dogi, wi’i yimɓe ɓee yo njokku e amen
Min ñaagiima ɓe, kono ɓe tiiɗnii ɓerɗe maɓɓe, ɓe njippii e amen
E nder wullaango wooto bonngo ummoraade e asamaan, wuro men ngoo fof muumɗi

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Jaɓaaɗo e noddiraaɗo fenaande e juuɗe wuro ngoo
Burned nguurndam e nder yiite mawnge ɓuuɓnge
Liɗɗi mawɗi ɓuuɓɗi e nder maayo luggiɗngo
Torlaa e nder ɓuuɓri yiite ɓuuɓɗo
trial.answer: Jaɓaaɗo e noddiraaɗo fenaande e juuɗe wuro ngoo

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Wuro ngo yani ko e wullaango wooto (Sayha) .
Tippuɗo oo e konu mum njippii e maayo fecciingo ngoo
Yimɓe ɓee mbayliima wonti ɓowɗi e ɓowɗi
Toɓo kaaƴe ummoriiɗo dow asamaan halki wuro ngo
Ilam bonɗam ɓuuɓni renndo ngoo fof
outcome.answer: Wuro ngo yani ko e wullaango wooto (Sayha) .

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
